metadata.description: Free, plainly written kits for small businesses and nonprofits.

plugins.name: grants
plugins.description: Find funders, track deadlines, research each funder and draft applications whose every number traces to a source.

plugins.name: board-packet
plugins.description: Get the monthly board packet out: gather reports, write minutes from a recording, combine one PDF and draft the board email.

plugins.name: books
plugins.description: Check your QuickBooks books without changing them, and turn them into a clear monthly treasurer report.

plugins.name: plain-writing
plugins.description: House style rules, an AI-tell checker, a claims check and voice presets, so writing reads like a person who knows the subject.

plugins.name: idea-to-post
plugins.description: One flow from topic ideas to a published, measured post: research, draft, quality checks, images, export and publishing.

plugins.name: website-checkup
plugins.description: An outside-in check of your website and local listings, with fixes ranked by how much they matter.

plugins.name: ai-visibility
plugins.description: Ask AI models the questions your customers ask, and record whether you are named, cited or crowded out.

plugins.name: customer-research
plugins.description: Learn the words your customers use from reviews, Reddit and search suggestions, then test your wording on a persona panel.

plugins.name: owners-numbers
plugins.description: A one-page monthly scorecard from your own exports, plus break-even and pricing what-ifs.

plugins.name: continuity
plugins.description: The bus test: could the work go on if one person disappeared tomorrow? Score it, then write the runbooks.

plugins.name: measure
plugins.description: Set up analytics properly, see AI traffic, write a monthly report and check causes before claiming them.

plugins.name: civic-voice
plugins.description: Show up prepared for public meetings, request public records, and pull your county's census numbers.

plugins.name: builders-toolkit
plugins.description: For people building with Claude Code: design checks, capability ledgers, session briefs and the rule that scheduled jobs never fail quietly.

plugins.name: ad-and-social
plugins.description: Ad copy, ad pictures and posts for X, Facebook and Instagram that sound like you.
